fields.description: Short stable identifier for this website (e.g. playnova). Lowercase, no spaces. Frontends never send this — it is resolved from the authenticated API user.
fields.label: Site Key

fields.description: Untick to instantly cut off this website's API access without deleting anything.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Public base URL of the website (e.g. https://playnova.com). Used to build canonical URLs in API responses. No trailing slash.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: The API consumer User for this website. Generate API Key/Secret on that User; requests authenticated as it are served this website's posts. One user per website.
fields.label: API User
